Project: LLM-powered Knowledge Assistant (0 to 1 build for enterprise document intelligence).

  • Took an AI product from concept to production, building an LLM-powered assistant for semantic search, document Q&A, and workflow automation.
  • Designed and shipped a full RAG pipeline from chunking and embeddings to retrieval and generation using OpenAI and Hugging Face with Pinecone and FAISS.
  • Built data pipelines for unstructured enterprise content including PDFs, CSVs, and internal documentation for natural-language querying.
  • Implemented backend services in FastAPI for ingestion, embedding workflows, and low-latency inference APIs.
  • Added streaming LLM responses and async workflows to improve responsiveness under heavy model workloads.

Focus: AI-powered clinical assistant (documentation, summarization, and provider workflows).

  • Owned a core documentation feature set that turned raw visit conversations into draft clinical notes clinicians could review and finalize quickly.
  • Shipped and improved a clinical summarization workflow focused on one clear outcome: reducing after-hours charting for busy providers.
  • Built context-aware retrieval features that pulled relevant patient and clinical context into note generation, improving usefulness in real encounters.
  • Partnered directly with product and design to make AI outputs understandable for non-technical users and trustworthy in daily workflows.
  • Improved quality and reliability with practical evaluation loops, focusing first on real clinician pain points rather than abstract model metrics.
  • Supported HIPAA-aligned implementation patterns, including safer data handling, auditing considerations, and access control guardrails.

Project: Vehicle product recommendation and maintenance selection experience.

  • Focused on one mission-critical feature: helping users choose the right oil and maintenance products based on their exact vehicle profile.
  • Built backend services in Java and Python for compatibility checks, product lookup, and recommendation logic across a large catalog.
  • Improved API and data flow reliability so product recommendations were faster, clearer, and more consistent for end users.
  • Automated ingestion and validation for vehicle specification and compatibility datasets to reduce manual errors and operational overhead.
  • Investigated and resolved production issues impacting recommendation quality and service reliability in high-usage environments.
  • Worked closely with product and business teams to turn service-center and customer pain points into shipped improvements.
